lines.text: Today you will make sprites come alive with animation.
Animation is like a flip book.
Each page shows a slightly different picture. In Scratch, these pictures are called costumes.
If you switch costumes quickly, the sprite looks like it is moving.
A forever loop repeats its blocks forever.
Next costume, wait, next costume, wait… and the sprite keeps animating until you press stop.
Computers are very fast. Without a wait, the costumes change too quickly to see.
A short wait makes the animation smooth.
Add move and “if on edge, bounce”, and your sprite walks back and forth across the stage.
Setting the rotation style to left-right stops it walking upside down!
Now animate your own sprite in the Code Lab!
